chapter_note: Chapter has clear bipartite structure: a cosmological enumeration of grieving powers (Mother of the Living, First Man) in lines 3-19 represents substrate teaching, while lines 20-33 pivot to Mani's first-person autobiographical and pastoral grief (the holy Church, persecuted elect, souls headed to Gehenna). The editorial fatigue pattern is visible: cosmological_substrate vocabulary drops to zero in second half while ecclesial and hortatory vocabulary rises. The 'third griever = myself' move is the editorial seam where the cosmic enumeration is appropriated to anchor Mani's institutional concerns.
